want: 林道を走れる 2 人乗りの小さなオフロード車両 (4 輪、最高 40 km/h、積載 150 kg)。横転しても、乗っている人を守りたい

requirements.name: 使う頻度・年数
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer)

requirements.name: 路面の摩擦係数 (砂利)
requirements.basis: assumption (gravel; no public value found)

requirements.name: 路面の粗さ (ISO 8608 のクラス)
requirements.basis: assumption: the forest road taken as ISO 8608 class C. ISO 8608 covers unpaved roads too (https://www.iso.org/standard/71202.html); class C = 128-512 x 10^-6 m^3 at n0 = 0.1 cycle/m from the table in https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12544-013-0127-8 (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 縦の坂 (止まって発進できる一番急な坂)
requirements.basis: 林道規程 (林野庁): 縦断勾配は 12 % まで、100 m 以内なら 14 % まで; the steepest stretch, https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/hokkaido/keikaku/other/attach/pdf/sinrinkeikaku_taikei-32.pdf (not checked in this repository). The sustained 12 % is the forest loop's grade_high in data/catalog/tests.yaml (P4, T1, T2)

requirements.name: 横の傾き
requirements.basis: assumption (no basis found)

requirements.name: 段差
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 横風 (瞬間)
requirements.basis: 気象庁の風の強さの目安で、瞬間風速 30 m/s (平均風速では 20 m/s) とする (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 気温 (範囲の高い端)
requirements.basis: assumption (the hot end of a -10 to 40 degC range of use)

requirements.name: 水・ほこり (IP)
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer, dust and splashing water on a forest road)

requirements.name: 人数と荷重の組 (見る組)
requirements.basis: request (2 人乗り、積載 150 kg)
requirements.note: MVP は two_cargo (2 人 + 荷) だけを見る。empty・driver・two はまだ見ない。乗員と荷は設計の部品 (kind occupant / cargo)

requirements.name: 体格の範囲
requirements.value: 若年女性 5 % 〜 若年男性 95 %
requirements.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 体重 (強さの不利側)
requirements.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, 項目 N1 体重, 若年男性 95 パーセンタイル, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (read against the table, 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: 弱い人がいるか
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer)

requirements.name: 積載
requirements.basis: request
requirements.note: 乗員とは別の荷として扱う (聞いていない)

requirements.name: 荷の重心の高さ (荷台の床から)
requirements.basis: the demo design's cargo: its box centre at 600 mm stands 150 mm above the deck's top at 450 mm (data/designs/offroad-4w-v1.json, parts cargo and deck)

requirements.name: 足を置く面どうしの高さの差の上限 (段と段、最後の段から床まで)
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Table 1 (between steps max 300 mm; last step to door sill max 300 mm), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 1 B (riser 230 to 400 mm, basic 300 mm), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 足を置く面の幅の下限
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Table 1 (width of step min 150 mm; footnote: for practical reasons not less than 250 mm), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 1 C (one foot 160 mm min, both feet 320 mm min), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 足を置く面の外の縁から先の、つま先が入る空きの下限
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Table 1 (clearance from the outside edge of the step min 150 mm), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 1 F2 (toe clearance min 150 mm, basic 200 mm), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 開口を、乗る人が道具なしに片手・一つの動作で開けられること
requirements.basis: assumption. CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, preamble (occupant retention), read 2026-11-04, accepts a barrier the occupant puts in place with one hand in one operation, such as a door (said of closing; applied here to opening). 道路運送車両の保安基準 第25条第3項, read 2026-11-04: 鎖・ロープなど転落を防ぐ装置は扉の代わりになる. No force or time for opening was found

requirements.name: 乗り降りの手がかりの高さの上限 (足を置く面から上へ)
requirements.basis: ISO 2867:1980 7.8 (grab rails begin at max 1 600 mm above the ground or platform; continue to at least 900 mm above the last step), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 2 D, not checked here. an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read). Whether a hand hold is required at all for a floor below 1 m was not found in any source read (ISO 2867:1994 4.7 asks for three-point support above 1 m)

requirements.name: 手でつかむ所の太さ (直径か平行な面の間) の下限
requirements.basis: ISO 2867:1980 7.3 (grab rail or handle: 16 mm min, 25 mm recommended, 38 mm max), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 2 A (16 mm min, 38 mm max, 25 mm basic), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 最高速度
requirements.basis: request

requirements.name: 0 → 最高速度の時間
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 停止距離
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from 細目告示 第171条 第5項 (初速 35 km/h), https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/content/S171.pdf; the table is for vehicles of 25 km/h or less and others, not for this vehicle's class (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 止まっていられる坂
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from 細目告示 第171条 第5項, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/content/S171.pdf; the table is for vehicles of 25 km/h or less and others, not for this vehicle's class (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 航続
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 最低地上高
requirements.basis: EU 規則 168/2013 附属書 I (全地形車 L7e-B の下限), criterion (8) "ground clearance ≥180 mm", https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2013/168/annex/I; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.name: 倒れない角度 (Q30 の組で)
requirements.basis: fully loaded (two_cargo, as Q30): 24 deg from ROHVA 1 and ANSI B71.9 as summarized by CPSC (2020); the same summary gives 33 deg for two people and 35 deg empty (the last for public roads only) (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 安全率 (降伏に対して)
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 挟み込みの隙間
requirements.basis: ISO 13854:1996 の試し読み, Table 1, PDF p.7, https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/22598/44d1054ccf4f41e1adefb8020dbaaa13/ISO-13854-1996.pdf; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.name: 横転したときの保護枠 (ROPS)
requirements.basis: request (横転しても、乗っている人を守りたい)

requirements.name: 衝突の速さ
requirements.basis: assumption (the top speed, Q50)

requirements.name: 手の操作部に掛かる力 (握る点、前後・上下・回す向きのそれぞれ)
requirements.basis: assumption: UN Regulation No. 79 (1988 text), table "Steering control effort requirements" (M1, with a failure: 300 N) taken as the largest hand force in use (the table was read; using it as a design load is the assumption)

requirements.name: 手の操作部の握る点の動きの上限 (Q66 の力で)
requirements.basis: assumption (the range where the feel and position of the control do not change; no source)

requirements.name: 足の操作部に掛かる力 (踏む面、踏む向き)
requirements.basis: UN Regulation No. 13-H, Annex 3, 2.1.1 and 2.3.4 (50 daN, read by the intake department on 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: 足の操作部の踏む面の支えの動きの上限 (Q68 の力で)
requirements.basis: assumption (small against the control's travel; no source)

requirements.name: 公道を走るか
requirements.basis: assumption of this fixed file; Q70 is a required question and was not asked

requirements.name: 電池の電圧
requirements.basis: assumption (16 LiFePO4 cells in series x 3.2 V nominal)

requirements.name: 乗員と部品に掛かる横の加速度
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.3(e) (0.70 g; read by the intake department on 2026-11-03). The vehicle's own peak from its dynamics tests counts instead when it is larger

requirements.name: 乗員と部品に掛かる前後の加速度
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.3(b)(1) (peak braking coefficient 0.90; read by the intake department on 2026-11-03). The vehicle's own peak counts instead when it is larger

requirements.name: 乗員の肩・腰の位置 (点 R) を外へ押す力 (10 s)
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.5(c)(1)-(5) (read by the intake department on 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: Q77 の力を除いたあとの点 R の永久の横の変形の上限
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.5(c) (less than 25 mm; read by the intake department on 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: 材料と接合
requirements.basis: assumption (steel tube frame)

requirements.name: 出荷の形
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 乗員の空間の荷重の基準の質量 M (横 1.75 M J・後ろ 1.4 M J・上 20 M N)
requirements.basis: assumption (the R4 builder's M). The coefficients 1.75, 1.4 and 20 are OECD Standard Code 4 (February 2026), 3.5.2.1, 3.5.3.1, 3.6.1 (read), borrowed from tractors >= 600 kg; they stay in the R4 builder, the contract having no unit J/kg or N/kg for them

requirements.name: 泥や石を放す踏面の範囲 (車軸の真上から前へ)
requirements.basis: 道路運送車両の保安基準の細目を定める告示 (2023.9.22 版) 第178条 第2項 第1号 (read); a public-road rule for other traffic, borrowed: applying it to the occupants is an assumption

requirements.name: 泥や石を放す踏面の範囲 (車軸の真上から後ろへ)
requirements.basis: the same 第178条 第2項 第1号 (read; borrowed, an assumption as Q87). The tread above the axle beyond this arc counts too (assumption)

requirements.name: 手でつかむ所の太さの上限
requirements.basis: ISO 2867:1980 7.3 (38 mm max) and ISO 2867:1994 Table 2 A (38 mm max), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 悪路の走行距離 (疲労)
requirements.basis: assumption (no public basis found)

requirements.name: 運転時間
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer)

requirements.name: 乗り降りの開口の前後の幅 (座面より上で、人の胴が通る部分の最小)
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Figure 1 (450 mm min at 1 000 mm above the door sill, 470 mm min at 1 250 mm) and ISO 2867:1980 10.1 (450 mm min from 770 to 1 550 mm above the platform, 680 mm recommended), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read). The current ISO 4252:2007 and ISO 2867:2011 were not checked

requirements.name: 乗り降りの開口の前後の幅 (床から座面の高さまでの、足と脚が通る部分の最小)
requirements.basis: ISO 2867:1980 10.1 (300 mm min from the platform up to 770 mm), read 2026-11-04; ISO 4252:1983 Figure 1 gives 250 mm min for the lower part (the larger is kept), read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 乗り降りの開口の高さ (座面の面から上へ、ふさいではいけない最小)
requirements.basis: assumption: H = AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, I1 座高 (seat surface to vertex), young adults, men, 95 percentile = 985.2 mm (N 217), read 2026-11-04 in the table. No standard read gives a height above the seat surface

requirements.name: 乗り降りの開口の高さ (床・敷居から上へ、ふさいではいけない最小)
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Figure 1 (1 250 mm min above the door sill; its NOTE lets the measuring heights be lowered where the seat is reached straight from the footstep), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1980 10.2 recommends 1 300 mm or more from the floor in sit-down cabs, read 2026-11-04. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

requirements.name: 地面から最初の足を置く面 (床の上面か最初の段) までの高さの上限
requirements.basis: ISO 4252:1983 Table 1 (first step from level ground max 550 mm, widest normally inflated tyres included), read 2026-11-04; ISO 2867:1994 Table 1 A (max 700 mm, basic 400 mm), read 2026-11-04. The smaller maximum is kept. Both are an older edition of a standard for agricultural tractors or earth-moving machinery, borrowed for this vehicle (an assumption: no standard for a small open off-road vehicle could be read)

domain_picks.reason: 要件のファイルが試験 R7 操作部の荷重 (手と足の力を枠まで伝え、動かない)・R8 荷重の通り道 (部品と乗員の重さと加速度を枠まで伝える)・R1 静的強度・R4 横転時の保護枠 (ROPS) を選んだ
要件のファイルが試験 H1 干渉・H3 体格・手が届くか を選んだ

load_cases.title: 止まっているときの干渉 (座席を滑りの両端に動かしたときも)

criterion.basis: H1: no two bodies overlap at rest, the driver's seat at either end of its slide too, beyond what the rule allows (welded joints, bolted mounts up to MOUNT_MM, the rest TOUCH_MM: k4_geometry.model.allowance)

load_cases.title: 車輪が上下しハンドルを切ったときの干渉

criterion.basis: H1: through the wheels' travel and the steering's range nothing of a corner meets what it is not mounted to

load_cases.title: つながりが形の上で触れているか (つながる点 at_mm が両方の形の上、つながりの無い部品が無い)

criterion.basis: H1: every mechanical joint a part's connects_to names touches (gap at most 2 mm: the program management's figure; wires and hoses not counted), says where (at_mm) on both shapes within 2 mm, and no part is joined to nothing

load_cases.title: 部品と部材がモジュールの空間に収まっているか

criterion.basis: H1: every part and member inside its module's space (design.modules envelope, given by the packager)

load_cases.title: ハンドルを止めまで切れるか (前輪がフレームに当たらない)

criterion.basis: H1: the front wheels turn to the design's max_steer_angle (30 deg) without touching the frame

load_cases.title: 体格の範囲の両端で座れるか・膝と頭が当たらないか (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H3: the knees of a young male 95th percentile (AIST J5 buttock-knee length) clear the part ahead

load_cases.title: 運転者のペダルを踏む膝の角度が、体格の両端で楽な範囲にあるか (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: H3: the pedal knee of a female 5th and a male 95th percentile, each at their best place in the seat's slide, within 99-138 deg (Porter and Gyi 1998, read in Schmidt et al. 2014; the original not checked)

load_cases.title: 手の操作部 (steering_wheel) の握る点を 300 N で前後・上下・回す向きに押す (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: Q67: the grip moves at most 5 mm under Q66 300 N in each of the three directions; a grip on a part joined to nothing has no deflection and shows as free_parts

load_cases.title: 足の操作部 (pedal_accel, pedal_brake) の踏む面を 500 N で踏む (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: Q69: each pedal's face moves at most 5 mm under Q68 500 N; a pedal joined to nothing has no deflection and shows as free_parts

load_cases.title: どの部品も、枠まで繋がっている (横 0.7 g・前後 0.9 g・下 1 g を全部の部品と乗員に、2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: every part with carried_by reaches a frame member through parts its box touches (load_path: a part joined to nothing is a free rigid body, found by fe.precheck.rigid_body_check)

load_cases.title: 部品と乗員の重さと加速度 (横 0.7 g・前後 0.9 g・下 1 g) で、各部材の応力をその材料の許しと比べる (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: each member's von Mises stress over its own material's yield / Q61 1.5 (largest of these ratios): JIS G 3445 STKM13A (carbon steel tube for machine structural purposes) 215 MPa (3 members, not checked); JIS G 3466 STKR400 (square and rectangular steel tube for general structure) 245 MPa (51 members, not checked). Tolerance 0.3: as R7, HIRAKU's choice for the gap between a hand calculation and the frame's analysis (no source)

load_cases.title: 乗員の肩・腰 (点 R) を 725 N で外へ押す (2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: Q78: what stands outboard of point R moves less than 25 mm under Q77 725 N (the elastic movement taken as the bound of the permanent one); a point with nothing outboard counts in occupant_push_open. Nets on quick-release clips and doors are not counted (a barrier the occupant puts in place is taken off before the shoulder and hip tests: the US CPSC's proposed rule for ROVs, 79 FR 68964, sec. 1422.5(c)(4), read by the intake department). Tolerance 0.3: as R7, HIRAKU's choice for the gap between a hand calculation and the frame's analysis (no source)

load_cases.title: 段差 100 mm を2 人 + 荷で越える
段差 100 mm を2 人 + 荷で越えるときの前輪の力をフレームに

criterion.basis: yield 245 MPa (JIS G 3466 STKR400 (square and rectangular steel tube for general structure), not checked) / Q61 1.5

load_cases.title: 横転の保護枠: 横から 875 J・後ろから 700 J を吸わせ、上から 10 kN で押す (OECD Code 4 の静的試験を借りる、2 人 + 荷)

criterion.basis: R4 (OECD Code 4, 3.5.2.2, 3.5.3.2 and 3.8, borrowed): the roll bar, deflected by each loading, must not enter the occupants' space; the smallest gap over the loadings between the roll bar's members and the space of k4_geometry.occupant_spaces (the occupant box, widened to AIST D2 and raised to AIST I1 of a young male 95th percentile) stays at 0 mm or more. The code's second condition (the clearance zone left unprotected under the ground plane) is not in this quantity
